 A missing socket can stop a Saturday auto repair faster than a stubborn bolt. Fortunately, The Home Depot is dropping prices on mechanics sets, including the Husky 310-Piece Mechanics Tool Set With Tool Box for $99 (was $199), with SAE and metric tools. Our guide to the best mechanics tool sets helps you rate and compare different sets.
 The sale also includes impact sockets, combination wrenches, and smaller sets that fill gaps without the need to buy a full collection. The cheapest deal is the Husky 94-Piece Mechanics Tool Set With Case for $49.97 (was $84.97), a compact set for a truck or trunk.
 Our Favorite Mechanic Set Deals

 Photo: The Home Depot 
 Now $99 (was $199)

 Photo: The Home Depot 
 Work on SAE and metric fasteners with this Husky mechanics tool set that offers a broad starting collection for vehicle maintenance and garage repairs. The included tool box keeps the 310-piece assortment organized.
 Milwaukee 62-Piece Socket and Screwdriver Set
 Photo: The Home Depot 
 Now $149 (was $209)
 Buy at The Home Depot 
 Photo: The Home Depot 
 Switch between nuts, bolts, and screws with a 56-piece SAE and metric ratchet and socket set paired with six screwdrivers. The 3/8-inch drive assortment suits a range of everyday automotive and equipment repairs.
 GearWrench 232-Piece Mechanics Tool Set
 Photo: The Home Depot 
 Now $199 (was $319)
 Buy at The Home Depot 
 Photo: The Home Depot 
 Reach recessed fasteners with deep sockets and use the standard sockets where clearance is tighter. This 232-piece set includes SAE and metric tools in 1/4- and 3/8-inch drives, organized in a three-drawer storage box.
 More Mechanics Tool Set Deals at The Home Depot 
 Choose a general mechanics set to build your collection, or add specialized sockets and wrenches for jobs your current tools can’t handle.
